description: Change the person's call page right away, like their own clicks: cmd window (win log=activity, dec=decisions, board=status board, wrap=transcript, cards; state open, close, min, medium, large, max), cmd layout (preset halves, quarters, thirds, bigmid, bar), cmd move (win + slot l, m, r, b, tl, tr, bl, br, main, side; optional preset), cmd focus (project voicehook, salesengine, kunden, sonstiges or all: only that project's sections stay open in activity, status and decisions). Never spoken. Only when the person asks for it or it clearly helps (e.g. open decisions after asking one).
name: ui
title: Arrange the call page
